chapters.title: The Three Little Pigs. A story for Mia.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The Three Little Pigs. A story for Mia.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The third little pig was called Mia, and Mia was the cleverest of the three. She met a man with a load of bricks, and said:
phrases: The third little pig was called Mia, and Mia was the cleverest of the three.
She met a man with a load of bricks, and said:

segments.speaker: pig3
segments.text: Please, man, give me those bricks to build a house with.
phrases: Please, man, give me those bricks to build a house with.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: So the man gave her the bricks, and Mia built her house with them, brick by brick. So the wolf came, as he did to the other little pigs, and said:
phrases: So the man gave her the bricks, and Mia built her house with them, brick by brick.
So the wolf came, as he did to the other little pigs, and said:

segments.speaker: wolf
segments.text: Mia, Mia, let me come in.
phrases: Mia, Mia, let me come in.

segments.speaker: pig3
segments.text: No, no, by the hair of my chinny chin chin.
phrases: No, no, by the hair of my chinny chin chin.

segments.speaker: wolf
segments.text: Then I'll huff, and I'll puff, and I'll blow your house in.
phrases: Then I'll huff, and I'll puff, and I'll blow your house in.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Well, he huffed, and he puffed, and he huffed and he puffed, and he puffed and huffed; but he could not get the house down. When he found that he could not, with all his huffing and puffing, blow the house down, he said:
phrases: Well, he huffed, and he puffed, and he huffed and he puffed, and he puffed and huffed;
but he could not get the house down.
When he found that he could not, with all his huffing and puffing, blow the house down, he said:

segments.speaker: host
segments.text: And what happens next? That's in Mia's story.
